meta.description: Single source of truth for Ember 3.28->5.12 upgrade-regression findings. Separate from the compliance register (audit-reports/FINDINGS.json) on purpose: framework-upgrade bugs are engineering findings, not compliance findings, but they use the SAME merge/citation machinery (scripts/audit-merge.rb, scripts/citation-check.rb) and the same governance: the merge never closes or downgrades; only Scot closes a finding. See audit-reports/ember-upgrade/README.md.

findings.title: Masquerade confirm checkbox uses bare type="checkbox" on <Input>; @checked never binds so Continue is permanently inert

remediation.options: Change type="checkbox" to @type="checkbox" (component argument) so <Input> renders a checkbox and two-way binds @checked to this.confirmed. Same fix pattern applied to start-codes.hbs in PR #621.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-components finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11. Verified against installed ember-source 5.12 (isCheckbox getter keys off the @type ARGUMENT; in the Input template ...attributes precedes the explicit type={{this.type}}, so the bare HTML attr is overridden and the element renders type=text; the change handler routes to the value path, @checked is never written back). Reachability: modal.open('modals/masquerade') at controllers/user/index.js:1267 -> modal-container.hbs:230 renders the masquerade component (no dead twin). masquerade.js:59 confirm() gates on this.confirmed, which the broken control can never set true -> Continue silently does nothing.

findings.title: Focus-words 'Save for Re-Use' checkbox uses bare type="checkbox" on <Input>; toggle is inert and reuse never saves

evidence.snippet: <Input type="checkbox" @checked={{this.reuse}} style='margin: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; cursor: pointer;' />

remediation.options: Change type="checkbox" to @type="checkbox" so <Input> two-way binds @checked to this.reuse. Same class of fix as PR #621.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-components finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11. Same mechanism as the masquerade finding (isCheckbox keys off the @type argument in ember-source 5.12; bare HTML type attribute is overridden -> renders a text field, @checked inert). this.reuse is only set by this control (reset at focus-words.js:299) and read at :448/:486 to decide whether to persist the focus-word list for reuse; with the toggle dead the user can never opt in, so Save-for-Re-Use is silently non-functional. Not on the migration doc verified-safe list; fix #621 (2026-07-16) fixed start-codes.hbs/bound-select.js but missed this file (last touched 2026-07-08).

findings.title: Textarea @value bound to get-only computed substitution_string crashes on keystroke

evidence.snippet: <Textarea @value={{this.substitution_string}} class="form-control" placeholder="additional substitutions, one per line (stop break=I need to take a break)" />

remediation.options: Convert controllers/user/preferences.js:639 substitution_string to a writable computed ({get, set}) with an edit cache, mirroring the home_board_key_lines fix (controllers/organization/settings.js:67). The set() should stash the raw text and parse it into pending_preferences.substitutions.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(a). Target provenance: substitution_string is a GET-ONLY computed at controllers/user/preferences.js:639 (single-function form, no setter). The Textarea @value two-way bind writes on every keystroke -> set on a setter-less computed throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading call) - identical shape to the home_board_key_lines bug fixed 2026-07-16 per LEARNINGS. Reachability: live user-preferences route, Phrase Substitutions section (preferences.hbs:1072-1080), rendered unconditionally. NOT in the migration doc fixed list.

findings.title: Input checkbox uses HTML type= without @type; renders as text field and drops @checked binding

remediation.options: Change type="checkbox" to @type="checkbox" so the Input component runs its checkbox path and honors @checked.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(b) checkbox variant (functional break). Verified against installed ember-source: the Input template renders ...attributes BEFORE type={{this.type}}, so the splattribute is overridden to text; isCheckbox reads the @type NAMED arg, absent here -> renders input type=text, checked getter undefined -> @checked inert. Admin cannot toggle include_extras. Reachability: organization/extras admin route. Matches the org-settings checkbox gotcha in LEARNINGS 2026-07-16, fixed elsewhere but missed here.

findings.title: {{action}} modifier still used in register.hbs (deprecated RFC 1006, removed in 6.0)

remediation.options: Replace the three {{action ...}} modifier usages (register.hbs:32,356,367) with the {{on}} closure form already used elsewhere in this template.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 5 / D23 (known LOW, 6.0 blocker only; works at 5.12). Live modifier usages at register.hbs:32,356,367 (shifted by staging #616 from 32/340/351). Rest of register.hbs audited fresh and otherwise clean.

findings.title: Input type="date" passed as HTML attr (no @type); renders as plain text field

remediation.options: Change type="date" to @type="date" so the native date picker renders.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(b) widget-degradation variant. Same verified mechanism as the checkbox finding; @value binding intact so field usable via manual entry (hence LOW). Codemod mistranslated the curly input named-arg into an HTML attribute. Reachable org-subscription admin route.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(b) widget-degradation variant. HTML type=number overridden to text; numeric affordance lost; @value intact. Verified mechanism.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(b) widget-degradation variant (verified mechanism). Rollback date picker downgraded to text; @value intact. board/history is a live route.

findings.title: Input type="number" passed as HTML attr (no @type) on user-edit fields; renders as plain text field

remediation.options: Change type="number" to @type="number" at user/edit.hbs:82 (2FA code) and :282 (external_vocab_size).

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-templates finder on 2026-07-19. Class 11(b) widget-degradation variant (verified mechanism). Two occurrences: :82 (code_2fa) and :282 (external_vocab_size). Numeric affordance lost; @value intact. LOW.

findings.title: Router-class on('didTransition') GA pageview handler never fires in Ember 5.12

remediation.options: Replace the dead Router-class event listener with a RouterService 'routeDidChange' subscription (as routes/application.js already does with this.router.on('routeWillChange', ...)). Inject router: service() and register the GA pageview send in init() via this.router.on('routeDidChange', ...), reading this.router.currentURL / currentRouteName instead of this.get('url').

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-boot-routing finder on 2026-07-19. Breakage class A6 (KB docs/ember-upgrade/KNOWN-ISSUES.md:61) / audit Class 5 removed-API. Reachability proof: router.js:35-44 registers notifyGoogleAnalytics via Router.reopen. Verified against ember-source 5.12 dist: defaultDidTransition performs only updatePaths/notifyPropertyChange and does NOT trigger 'didTransition'; only 'routeWillChange'/'routeDidChange' are emitted. GA pageview tracking silently stopped. router.js last changed 2026-07-11, after the 2026-07-09 sweep; not on any verified-safe list. Low severity: analytics-only, no AAC communication-path impact.

findings.title: @babel/core peer and directly-referenced @babel transform plugins undeclared in package.json (satisfied only by hoisting)

remediation.options: Add explicit devDependencies for @babel/core (^7.25) and the three transform plugins named in ember-cli-build.js (@babel/plugin-transform-class-properties, -private-methods, -private-property-in-object) so the build no longer relies on npm hoisting to resolve them.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-build-tests finder on 2026-07-19. Class 9 (build pipeline / addon compatibility). ember-cli-babel ^8.2.0 (package.json:49) peer-requires @babel/core, and ember-cli-build.js:8-10 directly references three @babel/plugin-transform-* packages. None appear in package.json devDependencies (verified at SHA; devDependencies only lists @babel/eslint-parser and @babel/plugin-proposal-decorators). They resolve today only transitively/hoisted in package-lock.json - a lockfile regen or dedupe change could de-hoist and break the build. Matches KB Build section. Builds green today; latent.

findings.title: No deprecation surfacing (ember-cli-deprecation-workflow / RAISE_ON_DEPRECATION) despite EXTEND_PROTOTYPES:false and 6.0 trajectory

remediation.options: Add ember-cli-deprecation-workflow v4 with setupDeprecationWorkflow({throwOnUnhandled: true, workflow:[...]}) in app.js and/or EmberENV.RAISE_ON_DEPRECATION for CI, per KB Build section and the migration doc's own suggestion (docs/ember-5.12-migration-findings.md:209).

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-build-tests finder on 2026-07-19. Class 9 (build pipeline). Deterministically verified absent: no ember-cli-deprecation-workflow in package.json/package-lock.json, and no setupDeprecationWorkflow / registerDeprecationHandler / RAISE_ON_DEPRECATION anywhere under app/frontend (grep clean at SHA). With EXTEND_PROTOTYPES:false (environment.js:14) and the app approaching 6.0 (where EXTEND_PROTOTYPES, the action modifier, separate-template resolution all become removals), there is no mechanism surfacing 5.x deprecations that gate the next major. Config/process gap, not runtime breakage - hence low/medium. The migration doc itself (line 209) recommends this tooling.

findings.title: No regression tests over the migration-doc Class 1-4 fixed paths; no @ember/test-waiters despite fetch-heavy sync

remediation.options: Add targeted regression tests for the 2026-07-09 fixed paths (native-array method replacements in utterance/persistence/log, @each A()-wrapping in preferences skin-tone / inflections, converted-modal opening() wiring, block-param template renders), and adopt @ember/test-waiters (waitForPromise/buildWaiter) around persistence.sync and speecher fetch chains so settled() actually blocks on them.

findings.notes: Surfaced by ember-build-tests finder on 2026-07-19. Class 10 (test-harness gap), grouped LOW as scoped. (1) The curated regression-import list in test-helper.js:59-71 contains none of the migration Class 1-4 fixed paths; the migration doc states these were only caught by manual UI verification (docs/ember-5.12-migration-findings.md:208). A Class-1..4 regression would re-ship green. (2) @ember/test-waiters is never imported in app/frontend/app (grep clean at SHA) even though the fetch-heavy stack issues native fetches invisible to settled() - assertions can race data loads and pass while the app is broken. Verified non-findings in same class: isTesting() used correctly (test-helper.js:7,13); no live moduleFor*/Ember.testing.
